svg.title: It therefore defines a bounded map on the source null quotient before completion. For v = P i aivi, the explicit finite-combination constant is Cv = P i |ai| pQvi, so the descent covers the whole algebraic word span. The induced completion unitary VH gives AZ = VHAV −1 H and preserves its norm. For whole-word compression let V0 identify the unselected ground spaces, and put CZ = V0CV −1 0 on the closed compression algebra. Recover a character by χZ(CZ) = χ(C).
